question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

In August next year, / she will been / studying / for four years.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb form "**been**" instead of "**be**" after "**will**."
 
• In future continuous tense, the correct structure is "will be" followed by the verb ending in -ing.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**she will be studying**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"In August next year, **she will be studying** for four years."*
